+"""Standalone copy of ``_pytest._code.source.getrawcode``.
+
+This module is importable by file path without loading ``_pytest``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import types
+
+
+__all__ = ["vendored_raw_code", "vendored_raw_code_variant"]
+
+
+def vendored_raw_code(obj: object, trycall: bool = True) -> types.CodeType:
+    """Return code object for given function."""
+    try:
+        return obj.__code__  # type: ignore[attr-defined,no-any-return]
+    except AttributeError:
+        pass
+    if trycall:
+        call = getattr(obj, "__call__", None)
+        if call and not isinstance(obj, type):
+            return getrawcode(call, trycall=False)
+    raise TypeError(f"could not get code object for {obj!r}")
+
+
+getrawcode = vendored_raw_code
+
+
+def vendored_raw_code_variant(obj: object, trycall: bool = True) -> str:
+    """Return the ``co_name`` of the code object for given function."""
+    return vendored_raw_code(obj, trycall=trycall).co_name

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import types
+
+import pytest
+
+
+MODULE_PATH = (
+    Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src" / "standalone_wave6_raw_code.py"
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def mod() -> types.ModuleType:
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_wave6_raw_code_under_test", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def sample_function() -> None:
+    pass
+
+
+class CallableObject:
+    def __call__(self) -> None:
+        pass
+
+
+class Empty:
+    pass
+
+
+def test_module_does_not_import_pytest_source() -> None:
+    text = MODULE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "_pytest" not in text.replace("``_pytest", "")
+    assert "import pytest" not in text
+
+
+def test_exports(mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+    assert set(mod.__all__) == {"vendored_raw_code", "vendored_raw_code_variant"}
+    assert mod.getrawcode is mod.vendored_raw_code
+
+
+class TestVendoredRawCode:
+    def test_function(self, mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+        assert mod.vendored_raw_code(sample_function) is sample_function.__code__
+
+    def test_lambda(self, mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+        f = lambda: None  # noqa: E731
+        assert mod.vendored_raw_code(f) is f.__code__
+
+    def test_callable_instance(self, mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+        obj = CallableObject()
+        assert mod.vendored_raw_code(obj) is CallableObject.__call__.__code__
+
+    def test_callable_instance_without_trycall(self, mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="could not get code object"):
+            mod.vendored_raw_code(CallableObject(), trycall=False)
+
+    def test_class_is_rejected(self, mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="could not get code object"):
+            mod.vendored_raw_code(CallableObject)
+
+    def test_empty_object(self, mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="could not get code object for"):
+            mod.vendored_raw_code(Empty())
+
+    def test_none(self, mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="None"):
+            mod.vendored_raw_code(None)
+
+    def test_builtin_call_without_code(self, mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+        # Builtins have a ``__call__`` without ``__code__``; recursion stops.
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+            mod.vendored_raw_code(len)
+
+    def test_recursion_uses_local_alias(
+        self, mod: types.ModuleType, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
+    ) -> None:
+        calls: list[tuple[object, bool]] = []
+        original = mod.vendored_raw_code
+
+        def spy(obj: object, trycall: bool = True) -> types.CodeType:
+            calls.append((obj, trycall))
+            return original(obj, trycall=trycall)
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(mod, "getrawcode", spy)
+        obj = CallableObject()
+        assert original(obj) is CallableObject.__call__.__code__
+        assert len(calls) == 1
+        assert calls[0][1] is False
+
+    def test_does_not_load_pytest(self) -> None:
+        code = (
+            "import importlib.util, sys\n"
+            f"spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', {str(MODULE_PATH)!r})\n"
+            "m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n"
+            "spec.loader.exec_module(m)\n"
+            "assert m.vendored_raw_code_variant(lambda: 0) == '<lambda>'\n"
+            "assert not [n for n in sys.modules if n.split('.')[0] in ('_pytest', 'pytest')]\n"
+        )
+        subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], check=True)
+
+
+class TestVendoredRawCodeVariant:
+    def test_function(self, mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+        assert mod.vendored_raw_code_variant(sample_function) == "sample_function"
+
+    def test_lambda(self, mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+        assert mod.vendored_raw_code_variant(lambda: None) == "<lambda>"
+
+    def test_callable_instance(self, mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+        assert mod.vendored_raw_code_variant(CallableObject()) == "__call__"
+
+    def test_trycall_false(self, mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+            mod.vendored_raw_code_variant(CallableObject(), trycall=False)
+
+    def test_empty_object(self, mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="could not get code object"):
+            mod.vendored_raw_code_variant(Empty())
